About the Artist

Genre: Acoustic Rock • 90s Alternative • Southern Rock & Americana

Brian Quinn blends acoustic rock, 90s alternative, Southern influences, and crowd favorites into a performance that's equal parts concert and singalong. From Alice in Chains Unplugged and Allman Brothers classics to original music and unexpected deep cuts, Brian's shows are built on great songs, audience connection, and the belief that live music should feel personal.
